notes: Second round. The first round claimed the -ang final against other Chinese names and failed on two near misses (' Beijing' 0.344, 'hou' in Zhou 0.313), so the pole reaches other pinyin too. New label: Chinese pinyin names against European names in the same frames. This is a different contrast, not the same test with easier near misses: the first-round result stands for the narrower claim.
